أتكالم (form VI)
# أَتَكَالَمُ (ʔatakālamu) /ʔa.ta.kaː.la.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# أَتَكَالَمَ (ʔatakālama) /ʔa.ta.kaː.la.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# أَتَكَالَمْ (ʔatakālam) /ʔa.ta.kaː.lam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
